title: Christoffel Adaptive Sampling for Sparse Random Feature Expansions
summary: Random Feature Models (RFMs) have become a powerful tool for approximating multivariate functions and solving partial differential equations efficiently. Sparse Random Feature Expansions (SRFE) improve traditional RFMs by incorporating sparsity, making it particularly effective in data-scarce settings. In this work, we integrate active learning with sparse random feature approximations to improve sampling efficiency.
